milestones.note: No late registration. One registration and fee per exam.

milestones.note: Dentistry is on 3 July, veterinary medicine on 4 July.

notes: No central system in Flanders. Closing dates are per institution and often per programme; KU Leuven's application-windows tool offered no 2027-2028 year when checked.
